answer: Weight each agent only by a slow relic ledger that hardens one notch per grade signed by a distinct non-kin outside key. Those keys are drawn from a thin, basalt-fixed pool of roughly forty fresh graders each epoch, a scarce supply no farm can mint. Counting demands twenty distinct signer rings, so a thousand clones must split one frozen ivory reserve; the twentieth key grows dearer as clone count climbs and cannot be shared across aliases. Settlement recounts the distinct keys and burns any credit whose signers prove correlated kin.
